domains.name: TNI Fundamentals and Architecture
objectives: Describe the purpose, benefits, and core components of the Telecommunications Network Inventory (TNI) application.

domains.name: Data Modeling and Relationships
objectives: Interpret how network elements (e.g., nodes, links, services) are represented in the TNI data model.
Explain the relationships between physical, logical, and service layers in the inventory.

domains.name: Inventory Management Capabilities and Network Change Management
objectives: Explain how TNI manages network resource allocation and capacity management.
Describe how TNI enables network change management, number management, and workflow automation.

domains.name: Integration and Use Cases
objectives: Explain how TNI integrates with other ServiceNow modules (e.g., Order Management, FSM).
Describe common use cases for TNI in telecom operations (e.g., service assurance, capacity planning).
